contentText:
Around the world in 80 WAVs. | Screenshot: Terrence O’Brien / The Verge

I love field recordings. I love making them. I love them when they're incorporated into my ambient music . They're great background noise for working or sleeping. But they're also great for active listening, focusing in on the fine nuances of burbling brooks or urban chaos. Earth Garden gives you a globe to explore with real field recordings taken from various locations. Earth Garden is inspired by Radio Garden (which you should also check out) except, instead of exploring the world via radio, it's environmental sounds.
